description: Multisig address fingerprints (NETWORK_IDENTITY.md NI-R15; the signing envelope §2.6): frame(shekyl/multisig-address-v3, name_id, [canonical payload]), name_id the network's name binding, for one fixed 2-of-2 payload (B = 0xB1 x32, Y = 0x71 x32, KEM key i = byte i x1216) on each network. Written and checked by scripts/kat/multisig_fingerprint_oracle.py; read by shekyl-address's address_fingerprint_kat.
